notes.title: Cricket Club Update 7 Now Live
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31509885/f323b724954a7e8830274434bf2bfa4d0c83c1d6.jpg

Time for a new update! We are pushing all the changes from the beta branch live and we also have a bunch of new features and goodies available!

Brand New Features

 Play at the Eden Park Outer Oval in County mode
 Choose your bat branding in the shed
 Increased fast bowler pace
 Lowered overall bounce
 New options for Oculus controllers
 New option to disable ground collisions
 New option to trigger replay by waving bat overhead
 Wagon wheel now displayed between overs


Features From Beta
Create Your Own Team

 Create as many teams and players as you like
 Batting stats for all players are tracked for each match type and difficulty mode
 Set the batting lineup for each type of match
 Bat in partnerships
 Access the teams interface on the desktop companion display 
 Use the teams interface to set the active team that you will bat with when starting a match
 Use the teams interface to set a team into training mode if you'd like to disable stat tracking (e.g. when demoing to your friends)


Autosave Matches
Matches will now automatically save at the end of each over so you can resume that long test innings when you have time. One autosave is stored for each match type and difficulty. When you start a new game and an autosave is found you will be given the option of resuming the saved game or starting a new one.

Certificate Challenges
A large array of challenges are now able to be completed. Each challenge will unlock a custom certificate which will be displayed in your shed. Check the Steam Achievements descriptions for how to earn each certificate.

Physics Improvements
There are a number of improvements to physics in this update. In particular the ball is bouncing more realistically now.

Fielding Improvements

 Improved the fielder AI
 Fixed a bug where fielders would not orientate correctly
 Run scoring will now take into account the fielder throwing the ball to the closest set of stumps
 Reworked the catching so that fielders are more likely to drop difficult chances
 Lots of new field sets


Misc Fixes & Improvements

 The tracker bat should be correctly oriented now
 Replays can now be triggered after the last ball of the innings
 The wickets are now part of the replay recording so you can watch the bails flying
 Any time you are presented with a 'Go' ball that you need to hit to continue, you can alternatively just press the trigger button to continue
 The menu button can now be used to bring up the scorecard at any time
 Scorecard has been updated to highlight the striker and non-striker
 Fixed a bug where you would be unable to pick up a bat after returning to the shed

It has been a while but we finally have a massive update ready for you! Because this update contains some experimental features (such as the 'Create Your Own Team' feature) we have chosen to release this on a beta branch so you have the choice to opt in and let us know what you think! To access the new update right click Cricket Club in your Steam library and choose Properties > Betas and then opt in to the beta branch.

Create Your Own Team

    Create as many teams and players as you like
    Batting stats for all players are tracked for each match type and difficulty mode
    Set the batting lineup for each type of match
    Bat in partnerships

    Use the teams interface to set the active team that you will bat with when starting a match
    Use the teams interface to set a team into training mode if you'd like to disable stat tracking (e.g. when demoing to your friends)


Autosave Matches
Matches will now automatically save at the end of each over so you can resume that long test innings when you have time. One autosave is stored for each match type and difficulty. When you start a new game and an autosave is found you will be given the option of resuming the saved game or starting a new one.

Certificate Challenges
A large array of challenges are now able to be completed. Each challenge will unlock a custom certificate which will be displayed in your shed. Check the Steam Achievements descriptions for how to earn each certificate. Note that these aren't hooked up to trigger the Steam Achievements just yet - this will be coming soon.

Physics Improvements
There are a number of improvements to physics in this update. In particular the ball is bouncing more realistically now.

Fielding Improvements

    Improved the fielder AI
    Fixed a bug where fielders would not orientate correctly
    Run scoring will now take into account the fielder throwing the ball to the closest set of stumps
    Reworked the catching so that fielders are more likely to drop difficult chances
 

Misc Fixes & Improvements

 The menu button can now be used to bring up the scorecard at any time
 Scorecard has been updated to highlight the striker and non-striker
 Fixed a bug where you would be unable to pick up a bat after returning to the shed

notes.title: Patch 5.2 Now Live
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31509885/18f885469d888a66b93479ec769b8ec3a199a583.pngThanks to everyone who provided feedback on the latest update we have added a few more improvements to the game.

Improvements

 There is a new option in the settings menu to change the length of the bats to a height that feels comfortable for you
 Changes to the bat physics should see the ball coming off the bat better than before - in particular edges, glances, deflections and shots behind square will now use the bowlers momentum more effectively
 The diving fielder no longer has super human reflexes or arm reach
 The new swing bowlers added in the latest update have been given their own hairstyles so you can easily tell who is bowling


Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the ball could get stuck beneath the umpire - there is now a catch-all timeout which will progress the game to the next ball in any situation where a fielder is unable to reach the ball
 Fixed a bug where the ball wouldn't disappear after being retired hurt

notes.title: Patch 5.1 Now Live
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31509885/6b12bd16b4c90b4d48ad490b8f7ee921d75663e6.jpg

This is a small patch aimed at fixing the issue a number of people were experiencing with the buttons for replay/pause not being detected.


 Reworked the input detection system to native SteamVR rather than relying on the Unity abstraction. Please let us know if this fixes the replay/pause issue for you!
 Fixed a bug where the concussion counter was not resetting in between batsmen when you got hit on the helmet.
 Change to spin bowling: the max amount of turn generated is now affected by the bowling speed. This means that a quick and flat delivery will not turn as much as a slow tossed up delivery.
 Minor tweaks to the bowler pitch maps in Test mode.


Hope everyone is enjoying the gripping contest over in England at the moment!

notes.title: Update 5 Now Live
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31509885/5610de05ed4d8ecea149d96f15658727b2fd0537.png
We're very excited to announce the new update is now available! Thanks so much to everyone who has left reviews and feedback with the stuff you'd like to see added to Cricket Club. We're pleased to have been able to pack a lot of your requests into this update :)

 New Instant Replay Feature 
Can't believe you missed that last delivery? You can now trigger an instant replay to watch what happened in slow motion. You can queue the replay anytime after you've played your shot by pressing the trackpad button. It will start playing as soon as the ball has been fielded.

 Replay Controls 

 Menu Button - Exit replay early
 Left/Right Trackpad - Manually step backwards / forwards through the replay


 Using a Real Bat? 
You can trigger a replay by waving your bat above your head after your shot

 New Difficulty Mode 
Cricket Club now has 3 difficulty settings: Club, County & Test. The existing Test mode has been rebranded as County level (with all high scores being ported across) and the new Test mode offers a much more challenging array of bowlers.

 New Bowlers & Delivery Types 

  Swing Bowlers:  E Chatfield the right arm swing bowler and G. Troup the left armer have been added into the attack at Test level.
  Seam Bowling:  J. Mantis the medium pacer will now seam the ball when playing at Test level.
  Slow Balls:  The quicks now have a genuine slow ball variation in Test level
  Arm Balls:  The spinners now have the ball that carries on straight added to their arsenal at Test level.
  Flighted Deliveries:  The spinners will now vary their speed and flight with more tossed up deliveries.


 Did you nick that? 
The fielders will now appeal for caught behinds and other close calls. Don't worry though, our eagle eyed umpires know just how to respond to over-zealous appeals!

 Other Changes 

 The size of the fielders has been reduced by a small amount
 The big screen at the Basin will now show the last delivery speed
 Fielders will now hold onto some of those diving catches/saves
 The square-leg umpire and the non-striker will now take cover if the ball is coming at them
 You can now trigger the next delivery by pressing the trigger button as soon as the bowler is at their mark
 The instruction booklet in the shed has been updated to reflect the new controls
 Reduced the amount of bounce generated in the outfield
 Minor tweaks to the way physics is applied to blocks and softer shots
 Decreased volume on collisions in the shed
 

 Fixes 

 Fixed a bug where the game could freeze after the helmeted fielder took a catch
 Fixed a bug where a duplicate fielder might appear after a catch/drop
 Fixed a bug where the menu button was sometimes being ignored 
 The bowler will no longer start bowling if there is a UI in front of your eyes
 Fixed a bug where being retired hurt would cause your innings to end on 9 wickets
 The umpire will no longer call a wide off a ball that has bounced off the helmet
 The stumps will now reset properly if you are bowled on the last ball of an over
 Performance Improvement: Optimised resource loading
 Performance Improvement: The wagon wheel is now only kept for the current batter

notes.title: Update 4 Now Live
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31509885/45279f36eb12df09d93ca147d993eb5a3f7c3bdd.jpgOur next update is here and this time it's a smaller release that's focussed on addressing a number of the niggles that you guys have raised so far! As always we are striving to make things as enjoyable as possible so we encourage you to provide feedback and let us know what you'd like to see in Cricket Club! If you're enjoying Cricket Club please also consider dropping us a review and help us get the game into the hands of more players!

Improved Batting Physics
Much more accurate collision detection between bat and ball and an improved hotspot marker should help with the strokeplay. We've also refined the advantages you get for middling the ball and updated the ball bounce physics.

New Scoreboard
We've replaced our ugly floating scoreboard with a slightly prettier floating scoreboard. The scoreboard will also show you a ball-by-ball report of the current over as well as your current highscore for the current match type so you've always got a target to aim for.

Bowling & Fielding

 Most bowlers have had their pitch maps adjusted. The bowlers in club mode should be a little friendlier now.
 Offside wides will now be correctly called by the umpire
 Fielders will no longer catch you out off balls that have just about hit the turf
 The fielding team should be slightly more intelligent about deciding which fielder goes for the ball
 Added some more legspin friendly field settings


Bugs Squashed

 Fixed a bug where sometimes no fielder would collect the ball (especially wide balls to the left-handed batsmen that spun past the keeper)
 Fixed a bug where the ball would sometimes get stuck beneath a fielder and get run out to the boundary
 Fixed a bug where hitting the ball 17 million miles into the air could bypass our boundary fences
 Fixed a bug that allowed you to hit your wickets before the bowler bowled and then be unable to get out bowled on the following ball
 Fixed a bug where the umpire would not return to his position after getting knocked by a fielder

notes.title: Update 3 Now Live!
notes.notes:
We're really excited to announce our latest update is here! We have focussed on as many of the things that you have been asking for as we were able to get to this update. Here are the patch notes. We hope you enjoy and please do let us know how you're getting on with Cricket Club!

Leaderboard Overhaul

  There are now new leaderboards for both individual and team scores in each game mode across both Club and Test level
  The leaderboards will now display in-game. They are shown at the end of the match and you can also view up-to-date boards at any time by pressing the menu button.
  Posting of scores is now automatic (as long as you have entered a player name)
  You can still manually post your score at the end of an innings if you haven't set your player name yet
  You can now always see your own leaderboard rank even if you aren't in the top 10


Some New Faces Into The Bowling Attack!
Ok, technically they all have the same face, but we gave them different coloured hair so you can tell them apart!

Introducing:
R. Collinge  - Left arm fast-medium. Bowls a full nagging line on the off stump. Patiently wait for some width outside off or dispatch him back over his head?
C. Grimmett  - Right arm legspin. Drifts it in then rips it past the outside edge. Slog sweep anyone?

New Fielder Behaviours

 Fielders will now leap and dive towards balls that are tantalisingly out-of-reach
 The keeper no longer has super human reflexes when catching balls that have taken a large deflection off the bat
 Improved the way fielders attack and orient themselves towards the ball
 Fixed various bugs with the new moving fielders introduced last update - including removing their ability to summon inhuman bursts of speed! 


Trophies Are Up For Grabs!
We're introducing the first of the trophies that you will be able to win to start decking out your shed.

 Individual High Score Trophy 

 Bronze - 50+ Runs
 Silver - 75+ Runs
 Gold - 100+ Runs


 Team High Score Trophy 

 Bronze - 100+ Runs
 Silver - 200+ Runs
 Gold - 300+ Runs


 Settings & Controls 

 There is an updated settings menu where you'll be able to find new settings to tinker with
 You can now adjust the height that the controller attaches to the bat handle to make it more comfortable for players of different heights. You'll find the option in the settings menu.
 The trigger button no longer pauses the game. You can press the menu button to pause and view the leaderboards. The button is automatically blocked during delivery so you won't accidentally bump it while swinging!
 An icon now appears above the bowlers head to show where you need to look to trigger the next ball. You can toggle this off in the settings menu.


Taking Centre
You can now rearrange the position and orientation of the pitch to suit your own room setup. You do this in the game by 'taking centre'. When you're out in the middle stand at the location in your room you would like to be the centre of the pitch, and look in the direction you would like the pitch to run in. Now touch the bat to the ground and hold down the trigger button until the icon appears. Your preferences are automatically saved so you only need to set this up once.

Along with the above we have continued to improve the physics simulation and squashed a number of bugs with this update.

See you on the leaderboards!

notes.title: Update 1 Now Live!
notes.notes:
First of all we'd like to say a big thanks to the community who have provided us with invaluable feedback on the game so far. We're so happy to bring you this first update to cricket club! So many of the changes included in this update have come directly from the points you raised here on the community hub.

Here are the official patch notes:
- Improved the bat and ball physics for more realistic strokeplay
- There is now a greater emphasis around timing the ball and hitting the middle of the bat
- Added more variations in line and length for each of the bowlers
- Added haptic vibrations to the bat
- The hotspot will now stay on the bat until the start of the next delivery
- Improved the way fielders reach for the ball when catching & fielding
- Added a bunch of new fielder poses
- Fielders now sometimes drop catches based on how difficult the chance is
- Close-in fielders will now duck for cover if the ball is hit hard in their direction
- Added some new field variations for the quicks and the spinner
- While in the shed you can press the trigger button to drop your current bat and choose another
- Added an option in the settings menu to turn off the ball trail while bowling
- The vive menu button no longer restarts the innings (you can press ‘r’ on the keyboard to restart)
- Various bug fixes and performance improvements
